items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: The boys around there, Bob Hewlitt and all of the boys... Bob Hewlitt, was a legendary character around there. He was a big gangster.

ctx.x: After I left. At that time, I was working at the Nest. In 1923. And he killed Old Man Baron, right there. And then they didn't protect him, either. The boys around there, Bob Hewlitt and all of the boys, the sportsmen, or gangsters, or pimps, or whatever you want to call them, that was around there. They run all night, two nights, looking and trying to find, Finally said Yellow Charleston. But the white gangsters had hid him for awhile.
